dependency_download_commands.checkout:
RUN set -eu; \
    for attempt in 1 2 3; do \
        if go mod download; then exit 0; fi; \
        if [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ]; then exit 1; fi; \
        sleep $((attempt * 5)); \
    done
dependency_download_commands.product-catalog:
RUN set -eu; \
    for attempt in 1 2 3; do \
        if go mod download; then exit 0; fi; \
        if [ "$attempt" -eq 3 ]; then exit 1; fi; \
        sleep $((attempt * 5)); \
    done
